```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(pander)
library(rmarkdown)
library(tibble)

# citation_package: natbib
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE)




## create quantification
# f_quant <- paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S5-Quantification Results.xlsx")
f_quant <- paste0(l.a$outDir, "/定量结果-内标法（自动积分表格合并）.xlsx")
qc_cpds <- l.a$get_table_quant(l.a = l.a, overwrite = TRUE, filename = f_quant, sheet = "--")


l.a$cpds <- qc_cpds$cpds
l.a$data_qc <- qc_cpds$qc
l.a$has_qc <- !is.null(l.a$data_qc)

if (!l.a$has_qc) file.rename(f_quant, paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S4-Quantification Results.xlsx"))





# headMessage sheet-1 and path
head_msg <- l.a$head_msg
head_path <- l.a$head_path
grp_types <- l.a$grp_type %>%
  stringi::stri_split(fixed = "|") %>%
  unlist()
l.a$fig_tag <- ifelse(is.na(l.a$grp_type), "", "-merge")

## Other table path
other_table <- glue::glue("{rep}/{rpt}/others/Table.xlsx", rep = l.a$repDir, rpt = l.a$rpt_flow)



## sampleInfo sheet-1
if (l.a$has_qc) {
  spl_name_qc <- l.a$spl_info %>%
    filter(sample_type == "QC") %>%
    select(sample_name) %>%
    .[[1, 1]]
  fig_qc_0 <- sprintf("%s/figures/TIC/QC/%s.png", l.a$resDir, spl_name_qc)
} else {
  spl_name_qc <- "HQC"
  fig_qc_0 <- sprintf("%s/../../Calibrator/results/figures/TIC/QC/%s.pdf", l.a$resDir, spl_name_qc)
}

spl_name_sp <- l.a$spl_info %>%
  filter(sample_type == "SPL") %>%
  select(sample_name) %>%
  .[[1, 1]]
fig_sp_0 <- sprintf("%s/figures/TIC/SPL/%s.pdf", l.a$resDir, spl_name_sp)



# cover info
project_code <- l.a$head_msg["项目编号", 1]
project_name <- l.a$head_msg["项目名称", 1]
custom_inst <- l.a$head_msg["客户单位", 1]
custom_name <- l.a$head_msg["客户姓名", 1]
```


### 标准曲线


```{r cals}
df_cals <-
  glue::glue("{l.a$resDir}/Calibrators.best.xlsx") %>%
  read.xlsx() %>%
  tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    `物质名称` = Compound.Name,
    `保留时间（min）` = round(rt_sec, 1) / 60,
    `标曲方程` = label %>% str_extract("Y = .+(?=;)"),
    `相关系数R^2` = round(score, 4),
    `标曲范围` = paste(round(xmin, 2), round(xmax, 2), sep = " ~ "),
  ) %>%
  rowid_to_column("编号") %>% # 这里创建了名为“编号”的新列
  select(`编号`, `物质名称`, `保留时间（min）`, `标曲方程`, `相关系数R^2`, `标曲范围`)
df_cals %>%
  kbl("latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, caption = "保留时间指数表", align = "l", font_size = 10) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"), font_size = 10)
```

### 质量控制

每10个样本插入一个QC标样，通过QC标样的浓度回读判断标准曲线的准确性和仪器系统的稳定性，若QC准确度为80%~120%，则说明实验过程在控制范围内。QC的RSD ≤20%，说明系统稳定运行。

```{r qc-acc}
data_rsd <- l.a$get_table_stats(l.a, filename = NA, fill = NA, sheet = "--")
# data_rsd %>%
#  kbl("latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = "QC准确度") %>%
#  kable_styling(latex_options="striped")
# 处理数据框
data_rsd_modified <- data_rsd %>%
  rowid_to_column("编号") %>%
  # 修改第一列：去除方括号及其中内容
  rename("物质名称" = 2) %>%
  # 移除第二列（选择除第二列外的所有列）
  select(-3)

# 渲染表格
data_rsd_modified %>%
  kbl("latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = "QC准确度", longtable = TRUE, align = "l") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"))
```

```{r copy-extra, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
## copy calibrator figures

cal_fig <- glue::glue("{res}/figures/Calibrators.best{tag}.pdf", res = l.a$resDir, tag = fig_tag)

file.copy(cal_fig, l.a$outDir)
file.rename(new_fig, paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Figure S1-Calibration.pdf"))

#
tic_fig <- glue::glue("{res}/figures/TIC/SPL/TIC-SPL{tag}.pdf", res = l.a$resDir, tag = fig_tag)

## copy other tables for small

file.copy(d_others, l.a$outDir)
```
